headline: Per-instance test CA + deterministic SIGTERM container exit

items.title: Test harness generates a per-instance CA
items.body: The test suite previously reused a shared self-signed CA across runs, which made cert-rotation tests flaky against parallel runners. Each test instance now mints its own CA + server cert + client cert at startup, isolating runs from each other.

items.title: Container SIGTERM exit is deterministic
items.body: Aligns the daemon's signal handling with the container init so that `docker stop`/`podman stop` reliably produces the same exit semantics each shutdown. Removes a flaky race that occasionally left the container reporting OOMKilled-style codes after a clean stop signal.
